song.name: The Last Charge
song.plot: The assault on Nyktoros. The survivors throw everything into one final charge to reach the prison's heart and complete the seal — with the Rift tearing at full fury overhead. The desperate, doomed-strength rush of the final battle.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: the survivors / resistance ("we") with Anya leading the purpose; the final assault on Nyktoros's prison. Anchors: the Empire of the Void, the Legion of Souls, Nyktoros, the Underworld, the Rift at full fury, the survivors' last strength. No victory yet (the seal completes next in Eclipse of Destiny/Endless Night), no crossing to Eldoria yet (that is Across the Rift, late album), no New Ravenspire. Structure: Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro. Full-tilt war anthem. Suggested Suno direction: ferocious, cinematic finale-action — charge drums, brass, screaming guitars, galloping tempo, an anthemic roar.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: The Rift is roaring in a wounded sky, The Empire of the Void has filled the night. We have one charge, one moment left to try, To drive a seal into the endless light.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The last charge, to the prison's heart, The last charge, we tear the dark apart. Through the Legion, through the pain, We charge the dark, and break his reign.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: The Underworld is shivering with his roar, But we have nothing but our will to give. Whatever waits behind the final door, We meet it now — the reason that we live.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The last charge, to the prison's heart, The last charge, we tear the dark apart. Through the Legion, through the pain, We charge the dark, and break his reign.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: Hold the line, one breath, one flame, Fall and rise and fall again. For the dead and for the living, We are the storm that beats the empty.
